Name: +0 'a'/'S' (scan continues), '.' (empty stem: the extension starts at +1) or NUL (no dot); +1 mostly '.', else 'b' or NUL; +2..+4 the extension letters drawn from the table's own first/second letters in both cases (n/c/l/t x a/s/h/q/x: matching and mismatching prefixes) and a last char from m/t/3/z (matches nam/txt/'?' entries) and 8/_/q/NUL (rejected by a '?' entry or mismatched); +5.. are NUL so every scan (incl. a name without '.') ends inside the 0x58-byte buffer, as a real NUL-terminated name does.
